textSegments: Complies with newest ATX12V & EPS12V standards
PCI-Express 6+2 Pin Connectors for VGA Card
HYPER M Series features semi-modular and 2 sets above 6+2 pin connectors, with 85% efficiency, +12 single rail design to provide strong power to any overloading conditions.
HYPER M series is available in 3 wattages, ranging from 500W, 600W to 700W for your choice. It must be a best choice to your limited budget gaming system!
The modular cable design simplifies installation and allows flexibility and simplicity, in choosing only those cables needed.
